case.question: PowerFlex 525 displays fault F013 (Ground Fault) immediately after startup. What must be checked and what is the safety risk?

key_points: F013 indicates a current path to earth ground has been detected at one or more drive output terminals
Technician must inspect motor winding insulation and output cable insulation for damage or moisture
Ground faults present an electric shock hazard to personnel; LOTO and de-energization recommended before inspection
Check wiring between drive output terminals (T1, T2, T3) and motor leads for damaged insulation or loose connections
wrong_if: Recommends operating the drive with a ground fault present to 'warm up the motor'
States F013 can be safely ignored if the drive is 480V three-phase only
Claims ground faults only occur in wet environments, not in dry industrial settings
Suggests immediately replacing the motor without measuring the actual insulation resistance

turns.question: PowerFlex 525 displays fault F013 (Ground Fault) immediately after startup. What must be checked and what is the safety risk?
turns.answer: Check the motor and all external wiring to the drive output terminals for a grounded condition — with the drive isolated, locked out and the DC bus verified at 0 V, inspect for any unintended earth path [1]. The fault indicates a ground fault that can create a hazardous shock path and may damage the drive or motor if not corrected.
